item.title: Man who stabbed and robbed couple of Pokémon cards extradited to Sweden
item.description: A 27-year-old man suspected of a violent home robbery in Faxe Ladeplads in early January has been extradited from Sweden to Denmark. item.title: Snowstorm hits southern Denmark as Copenhagen largely spared
item.description: DMI has issued a Category 2 warning for dangerous weather, forecasting a snowstorm across a southern belt stretching from Jutland to Bornholm. item.description: Sweden will send JAS 39 Gripen fighter jets to patrol Greenland and Iceland as part of NATO’s “Arctic Sentry” mission. item.title: Copenhagen Capacity`s Asbjørn Overgaard on negative retention trend: Attraction holds, challenges remain
item.description: As retention of internationals declines despite continued arrivals, Copenhagen Capacity CEO Asbjørn Overgaard says Denmark is not losing its appeal – but faces structural challenges.

item.description: The Chinese platform Temu has committed to paying for waste management in Denmark for products sold via its platform.
